nodes.name: Note: WF-05a · Load the knowledge base (run manually)

parameters.content:
## WF-05a · Load the knowledge base (run manually)
Run **Execute workflow** after editing `knowledge-base/*.md` (mounted read-only at `/knowledge-base`).

1. Reads every Markdown file (front matter: `title`, `language`).
2. **Split Into Chunks**: one chunk per `##` section, prefixed with the document title so each
   chunk makes sense on its own.
3. **Embed Chunks**: one OpenRouter embeddings call per file (`LLM_EMBEDDING_MODEL`).
4. **Replace Chunks of File**: deletes the file's old chunks and inserts the new ones in one
   statement, so re-running is safe and never leaves duplicates.

parameters.query:
WITH removed AS (
  DELETE FROM kb_chunks WHERE metadata->>'source' = $1
)
INSERT INTO kb_chunks (text, metadata, embedding)
SELECT r.text, r.metadata, r.embedding::vector
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb) AS r(text text, metadata jsonb, embedding text)
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ 'WF-05a KB Ingestion', 'kb.ingested', null, null, 'Knowledge base loaded: ' + $json.files + ' files, ' + $json.chunks + ' chunks', JSON.stringify($json), $execution.id ] }}
